summary:
**Market summary, 2026-11-23** (covers the 2026-11-20 session and pre-market trading)

Equities fell sharply last session. SPY dropped 3.64%, QQQ 5.67%, and XLK 7.27%, making technology the weakest sector. Small caps (IWM -2.88%) and the Dow (DIA -1.98%) also declined. Defensive sectors held up better: staples (XLP +0.67%) rose and health care (XLV -0.12%) was near flat. Long Treasuries (TLT +1.37%) gained, gold (GLD -3.67%) fell, and VIXY rose 13.42%.

Pre-market indications at about 13:17 UTC point higher, with SPY at +2.66%, QQQ at +3.64%, and XLK at +4.10%. These are thin prints and may not reflect the open.

Michigan consumer sentiment came in at 51.5 against a 51.0 consensus. One-year inflation expectations eased to 3.7% from 4.7%. Today's calendar includes S&P Global PMIs, Treasury bill and 2-year note auctions, and a Williams speech at 16:00 New York time.

Stock-specific news: CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at about $43.9 billion. ZS is up 19.5% pre-market on thin volume. Nvidia rose after reports that the administration is pushing for Jensen Huang's reinstatement.
